messages.content: Help me generate the XContent with xContentBuilderInstance for a RootObjectMapper that includes default settings for dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, and numeric detection, while skipping runtime fields?

function.name: RootObjectMapper_doXContent
function.description: Serializes the RootObjectMapper settings to XContent, with options to include default values and to skip runtime fields. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

builder.description: The XContentBuilder to which the content should be written. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

params.description: Parameters controlling the serialization, including whether to include defaults and whether to skip runtime fields. This is Java ArrayList type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type any; they are not in string representation.

message.content:
Here’s how you would invoke the `RootObjectMapper_doXContent` function to serialize a `RootObjectMapper` into XContent while ensuring that all default settings (dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, numeric detection) are included and that runtime fields are skipped: ```json { "builder": "xContentBuilderInstance", "params": "[true, true]" } ``` **Explanation** | Parameter | Value | Meaning | |-----------|-------|---------| | `builder` | `"xContentBuilderInstance"` | A string representation of your `XContentBuilder` instance that will receive the serialized output. | | `params` | `"[true, true]"` | An `ArrayList` represented as a string where:
• The first element (`true`) tells the serializer to **include default values** (so dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, numeric detection, etc., are written out).
• The second element (`true`) instructs it to **skip runtime fields** during serialization. | When this JSON payload is passed to the `functions.RootObjectMapper_doXContent` endpoint, the underlying Java method will write the full mapping—including all default settings—to the supplied `XContentBuilder`, omitting any runtime fields.
